about.title: A Message from
about.quote: At P.S. 165Q, we believe every child is a Shooting Star — bright, unique, and capable of extraordinary things.
about.body: Welcome to our school community. For over six decades, P.S. 165Q has been a cornerstone of Flushing, Queens — nurturing young minds from Pre-K through Grade 5. Our dedicated staff works every day to build a solid, equitable foundation through critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, and communication. We are proud of our Gifted & Talented program, our NEST enrichment track, and the wide range of arts, athletics, and social-emotional learning opportunities we offer. We look forward to partnering with you on your child's educational journey.

mission.title1: Cultivating citizens of the world and
mission.body: We build a solid and equitable foundation through critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, and communication — preparing every student to thrive in a diverse, interconnected world.

programs.desc: Rigorous, enriching programs designed to inspire every learner.

gt.name: G&T Program
gt.desc: An accelerated curriculum for students identified through NYC DOE admissions. Emphasizes advanced problem-solving, independent research, and enriched content across all core subjects.

nest.name: NEST Program
nest.desc: Nurturing Excellence through STEM and the arts. Project-based learning with integrated technology for deeper engagement.

sel.name: Social-Emotional Learning
sel.desc: Building self-awareness, empathy, and responsible decision-making across every grade.

arts.name: The Arts
arts.desc: Visual arts, music, and theater — including celebrated annual productions and performances.

sports.name: Sports
sports.desc: Competitive and recreational athletics developing teamwork, discipline, and physical fitness.

lit.name: Literacy & Math Intervention
lit.desc: Targeted small-group instruction and tutoring to ensure every student meets grade-level standards.

tech.name: Digital Learning
tech.desc: 1:1 devices, coding curriculum, and digital citizenship for a technology-driven future.
